name: GLA-DPV: 2-group MLA + dual-path V
tagline: MLA with two independent KV latent groups and a per-head sigmoid-gated dual value path mixing the standard up-projection with a direct latent-to-value projection.

key_hyperparams.name: kv_lora_rank
key_hyperparams.role: rank per group (vs head_dim/2 in MLA)

key_hyperparams.name: v_dual_gate
key_hyperparams.role: per-head sigmoid gate between v_main and v_dual

init_recovers: MLA baseline when n_kv_groups=1 and v_dual_gate -> -inf
diff_from_baseline: Replaces MLA's single latent stream with two independent latent groups (each of rank head_dim, half the heads) and adds a per-head sigmoid gate that interpolates between the standard up-projected value and a direct lightweight v_dual projection of the latent; query path, RoPE handling, and o_proj are unchanged from the MLA baseline.

name: MLA + alternating-layer KV reuse
tagline: MLA backbone where odd layers reuse the previous even layer's latent KV (cross-layer sharing) instead of computing their own.

nodes.label: odd layer: pop cache (no new KV)

key_hyperparams.name: cross_layer_share
key_hyperparams.role: odd layers reuse previous even layer's latent

key_hyperparams.name: kv_lora_rank
key_hyperparams.value: head_dim*2 (declared); recomputed to int(head_dim*1.5) on the share branch

key_hyperparams.name: _shared_kv_cache
key_hyperparams.role: passes (kv_latent, k_rot) to next odd layer

init_recovers: MLA baseline when cross_layer_share returns False
diff_from_baseline: Adds cross-layer KV sharing on top of MLA: odd layers skip kv_a_proj and reuse the previous even layer's (kv_latent, k_rot) via a class-level dict, halving realized KV storage; storage_ratio is reported as 0 for reused layers. NOTE: the editable region contains a syntax error (a stray dedented assignment around line 110 plus a missing nn.Linear name), so the file would not import as-is.

name: Depth-aware grouped latent KV
tagline: n_head/2 KV groups with a depth-decayed latent rank, sigmoid intra-group gates, learnable head/skip biases, and a layer-anchored latent.

key_hyperparams.name: kv_lora_rank
key_hyperparams.value: max(16, head_dim/2) shallow; head_dim/4 when depth_frac>0.5

key_hyperparams.name: kv_skip
key_hyperparams.role: static skip bias mixed in via 1-gate

init_recovers: GQA when kv_gate -> +inf and anchor=0, kv_skip=0
diff_from_baseline: Replaces MLA's single-head latent + RoPE with a GQA-style design: n_head/2 KV heads each carrying their own depth-decayed latent (rank head_dim/2 shallow, head_dim/4 deep), expanded by kv_b to per-head k,v; intra-group entries are sigmoid-gated against a learnable kv_skip vector and the group-mean of v; queries are rescaled by a learnable per-head gain and the latent gets a depth-fraction-scaled anchor bias. No RoPE (use_pos_emb=True).

name: MLA with kv_lora_rank=56
tagline: Vanilla MLA layout (single KV head, RoPE rope-slice, dual LoRA Q/KV) tuned with kv_lora_rank=56 and qk_rope_head_dim=32 to push KV bytes below MQA.

key_hyperparams.name: kv_lora_rank
key_hyperparams.role: MLA latent rank (vs MLA baseline head_dim/2=32)

init_recovers: MLA baseline up to the latent-rank/rotary tweaks
diff_from_baseline: Same overall MLA control flow as the mla baseline (dual-LoRA Q/KV with RoPE rope-slice) but tunes the two rank knobs: kv_lora_rank=56 (vs head_dim/2=32 in baseline) and a fixed qk_rope_head_dim=32 instead of min(64, head_dim). Aimed at landing KV bytes/token below MQA's 2*head_dim.

name: MLA + odd-layer latent reuse
tagline: MLA with cross-layer sharing: odd layers pull the previous even layer's (kv_latent, k_rot) so half of the layers report zero KV storage.

nodes.label: odd layer: reuse cache, no new KV bytes

key_hyperparams.name: cross_layer_share
key_hyperparams.role: odd layers reuse previous layer's latent + k_rot

init_recovers: MLA baseline when cross_layer_share is disabled
diff_from_baseline: Compared to the mla baseline: cross_layer_share returns True on odd layers, so kv_a_proj/kv_a_layernorm are skipped and the cached (kv_latent, k_rot) is reused; latent ranks are increased to head_dim*5/4=80 for both Q and KV, the rotary slice is shrunk to head_dim/4=16, and storage_ratio is reported as 0 on reused layers.
